taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station H-01, survey area H. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 332.5 | 0.52 | 0.52
2 | 601.3 | 6.89 | 7.41
3 | 359.9 | 16.01 | 23.42
4 | 286.0 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as K-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station H-01, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Report: Station H-01 (Area H)**

Station H-01 exhibits a four-layer geoelectric profile:
- **Layer 1:** 332.5 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 0.52 m (depth to base: 0.52 m)
- **Layer 2:** 601.3 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 6.89 m (depth to base: 7.41 m)
- **Layer 3:** 359.9 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$, thickness 16.01 m (depth to base: 23.42 m)
- **Layer 4:** 286.0 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$ (basal layer)

Evaluating consecutive layer resistivity relationships:
- Layers 1–2–3: $\rho_1 < \rho_2 > \rho_3 \rightarrow \text{K}$
- Layers 2–3–4: $\rho_2 > \rho_3 > \rho_4 \rightarrow \text{Q}$

Combining these gives a four-layer **KQ-type** sounding curve. The on-file classification of "K-type" is incomplete and does not fit the full four-layer resistivity sequence.

{"curve_type_stated": "KQ", "label_issue_flagged": true}
